linhas.text: The third tip is about the importance of buying and selling players continuously throughout
the league. This step might seem simple, but it is by far the most crucial of all. Constant
buying and selling is the most effective way to generate money in the game.
And the best part? Buying players on the transfer list costs only one boss coin. Imagine
the profit potential you can achieve by maximising this strategy.
